info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bank Portfolio Review Submission API
info.description: The Bank Portfolio Review Submission API enables financial institutions to submit reviews related to their bank portfolio analyses. This API facilitates the input of qualitative and quantitative feedback, helping improve portfolio management outcomes. Typical consumers include treasury departments, financial analysts, and portfolio managers who rely on accurate assessments for decision-making. The submitted reviews support enhanced analysis and reporting of banking activities, driving better strategic insights.

post.summary: Create a review for a bank portfolio analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to submit a review for the specified bank portfolio analysis resource. It is designed to gather feedback and insights related to the analysis, enabling continuous improvement and assessment of bank portfolios.
